minor.issue: Set-Cookie attribute is 'SameSite=None; Partitioned' instead of 'SameSite=Lax' required by spec. backend/utils/security.py:192 sets samesite='lax' — the deviation appears to be edge/CDN rewriting on egress (CHIPS Partitioned). Cookie still functions (same-origin requests include it), but spec compliance fails.

integration_issues.issue: After POST /api/auth/logout (credentials:include) and reloading '/', viewer2 landed on /reels instead of /login. The backend logout test passes (cookie invalidated, token revoked), but the SPA still rendered a logged-in-like landing. Not fully diagnosed; may be that /reels is a public route or that AuthContext holds in-memory token until the next 401. Minor UX, not blocking.
